e-4683.knowledge_point: Finding the Coefficient Matrix of a System of Linear Equations
e-4683.problem:
What is the coefficient matrix for the following system of linear equations?

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14071100/assets/14671e805c18814b31d0c65d0e53c60aae1cf52c60ad8dd146d8a3f4bc823915.png)
e-4683.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that every variable has a coefficient:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14071100/assets/e0318c549ab4aa25bf2decb41e45e296406d699706c03aff7ea44724d20edece.png)

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
\left\lbrack
	\matrix {
		1 & -2 \
		0 & 2 
	}
	\right\rbrack
$$

e-4684.knowledge_point: Finding the Augmented Matrix of a System of Linear Equations
e-4684.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14071100/assets/a5abba041a61cad76d43d5bb13d0fd4e873eb2daf2282e8d9828b8ab79fe2ba0.png)
e-4684.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y,z$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14071100/assets/2f9ae37920ec528a700715658900bbbf3ec4c855767bf06f79d044f488a8bbf2.png)

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
\left\lbrack
	\matrix {
		1 & 1 & -3 \
		-7 & -1 & 1 \
                2 & 1 & -2 
	}
	\right\rbrack
$$

The augmented matrix  is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14071100/assets/af1499610c0c312a1f5c50d99967a004ae6b3042c3a88ca20a86f922b28aaaff.png)

e-4685.knowledge_point: Finding the System of Equations Associated With an Augmented Matrix
e-4685.problem:
What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14071100/assets/4d90e81043121495ae8bb7742400b2c9e705cb7d706f553a6ab2aec44b35d017.png)
e-4685.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix consists of two parts: the coefficient matrix and the column of constants.

The coefficient matrix represents the coefficients in the linear system, while the column of constants represents the constants on the right-hand sides of the equations.

Using the variables $x$ and $y,$ then, the corresponding system of equations is
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14071100/assets/3e7f783023405be3ea79a740998fefac3a6ea909e9903f5ea300a9234ae63003.png)

e-4686.knowledge_point: Finding the Augmented Matrix of a Linear System With Variables Other Than x, y, z
e-4686.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14071100/assets/d89417b7eb2d000bbd81fcf4a89ca7eaa5529fc56d9b41bf6e8bb237d2eb9e16.png)
e-4686.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $a,b,c,d$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14071100/assets/93874fa93cfd9ef3df1492bbc35056c2381157740d8ca26b475474faf54ee4d1.png)

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 & \frac{1}{2} & 0 \\ -1 & 3 & -4 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14071100/assets/8356d9148bc06d76a5aee41e4a07651c43d94b2496d9542eb8b6e01ee52ea161.png)

content.knowledge_point: Finding the Coefficient Matrix of a System of Linear Equations
content.problem:
What is the coefficient matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}-x+5y=2 \\ 2x+y=1\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
content.worked_solution:
The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables: 

$$
[\begin{aligned}-1 & 5 \\ 2 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

after.name: Question 2
after.problem:
What is the coefficient matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}5x-8y+z=-1 \\ 9y=2 \\ 3x-y-8z=-4\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
after.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y,z$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}5x-8y+z=-1 \\ 0x+9y+0z=2 \\ 3x-y-8z=-4\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}5 & \,\,\,-8 & 1 \\ 0 & 9 & 0 \\ 3 & \,\,\,-1 & \,\,\,-8\end{aligned}]
$$

verification.explanation: The worked solution confirms option c: the x, y, z coefficient rows are (5, -8, 1), (0, 9, 0), and (3, -1, -8). Option e includes the constants, making it an augmented matrix rather than the requested coefficient matrix.

content.knowledge_point: Finding the Coefficient Matrix of a System of Linear Equations
content.problem:
What is the coefficient matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}5x-8y+z=-1 \\ 9y=2 \\ 3x-y-8z=-4\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
content.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y,z$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}5x-8y+z=-1 \\ 0x+9y+0z=2 \\ 3x-y-8z=-4\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}5 & \,\,\,-8 & 1 \\ 0 & 9 & 0 \\ 3 & \,\,\,-1 & \,\,\,-8\end{aligned}]
$$

after.name: Question 3
after.problem:
What is the coefficient matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}x=6 \\ 9x+4y=-1\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
after.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}x+0y=6 \\ 9x+4y=-1\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 9 & 4\end{aligned}]
$$

content.knowledge_point: Finding the Coefficient Matrix of a System of Linear Equations
content.problem:
What is the coefficient matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}x=6 \\ 9x+4y=-1\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
content.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}x+0y=6 \\ 9x+4y=-1\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 9 & 4\end{aligned}]
$$

after.name: Question 4
after.problem:
What is the coefficient matrix for the following system of equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}x+3y=7 \\ 2x=4\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
after.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered  $x,y$ 
 on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
{\begin{aligned}x+3y=7 \\ 2x+0y=4\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 \\ 2 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

content.knowledge_point: Finding the Coefficient Matrix of a System of Linear Equations
content.problem:
What is the coefficient matrix for the following system of equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}x+3y=7 \\ 2x=4\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
content.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered  $x,y$ 
 on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
{\begin{aligned}x+3y=7 \\ 2x+0y=4\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 \\ 2 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

after.name: Question 5
after.problem:
What is the coefficient matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}-x+y=2 \\ x-y=-2\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
after.worked_solution:
The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables: 

$$

content.problem:
What is the coefficient matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}-x+y=2 \\ x-y=-2\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
content.worked_solution:
The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables: 

$$
[\begin{aligned}-1 & 1 \\ 1 & -1\end{aligned}]
$$

after.name: Question 6
after.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}2x-5=3y \\ 6+y=4x\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
after.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}2x-3y=5 \\ -4x+y=-6\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}2 & -3 \\ -4 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix  is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations: 

$$
[\begin{aligned}2 & -3 & 5 \\ -4 & 1 & -6\end{aligned}]
$$

content.knowledge_point: Finding the Augmented Matrix of a System of Linear Equations
content.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}2x-5=3y \\ 6+y=4x\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
content.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}2x-3y=5 \\ -4x+y=-6\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}2 & -3 \\ -4 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix  is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations: 

$$
[\begin{aligned}2 & -3 & 5 \\ -4 & 1 & -6\end{aligned}]
$$

after.name: Question 7
after.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}4x-y=4 \\ 8x=-7\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
after.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient: 

$$
{\begin{aligned}4x-y=4 \\ 8x+0y=-7\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}4 & -1 \\ 8 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix  is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
[\begin{aligned}4 & -1 & 4 \\ 8 & 0 & -7\end{aligned}]
$$

content.knowledge_point: Finding the Augmented Matrix of a System of Linear Equations
content.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}4x-y=4 \\ 8x=-7\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
content.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient: 

$$
{\begin{aligned}4x-y=4 \\ 8x+0y=-7\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}4 & -1 \\ 8 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix  is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
[\begin{aligned}4 & -1 & 4 \\ 8 & 0 & -7\end{aligned}]
$$

after.name: Question 8
after.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}6x+y+z=4 \\ x+z=9\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
after.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y,z$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}6x+y+z=4 \\ x+0y+z=9\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}6 & 1 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix  is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
[\begin{aligned}6 & 1 & 1 & 4 \\ 1 & 0 & 1 & 9\end{aligned}]
$$

content.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}6x+y+z=4 \\ x+z=9\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
content.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y,z$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}6x+y+z=4 \\ x+0y+z=9\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$

after.name: Question 9
after.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}2y=5-x \\ 5x-9y+1=0\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
after.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}x+2y=5 \\ 5x-9y=-1\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 \\ 5 & -9\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix  is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations: 

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 5 \\ 5 & -9 & -1\end{aligned}]
$$

Correct
EXPLANATION

First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered x,y on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

{x+2y=55x−9y=−1

content.knowledge_point: Finding the Augmented Matrix of a System of Linear Equations
content.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}2y=5-x \\ 5x-9y+1=0\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
content.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}x+2y=5 \\ 5x-9y=-1\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 \\ 5 & -9\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix  is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations: 

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 5 \\ 5 & -9 & -1\end{aligned}]
$$

after.name: Question 10
after.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}x-3=2y \\ 1+y=-2x\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
after.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}x-2y=3 \\ 2x+y=-1\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 \\ 2 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix  is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations: 

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 3 \\ 2 & 1 & -1\end{aligned}]
$$

content.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}x-3=2y \\ 1+y=-2x\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
content.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}x-2y=3 \\ 2x+y=-1\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 \\ 2 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix  is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations: 

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 3 \\ 2 & 1 & -1\end{aligned}]
$$

after.name: Question 11
after.problem:
What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

$$
[\begin{aligned}0 & -8 & 4 & -\frac{7}{4} \\ 0 & 5 & \frac{2}{3} & 8 \\ \frac{3}{2} & \frac{1}{3} & 4 & 6\end{aligned}]
$$
after.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix consists of two parts: the coefficient matrix and the column of constants.

The coefficient matrix represents the coefficients in the linear system, while the column of constants represents the constants on the right-hand sides of the equations.

Using the variables $x$, $y$, and $z,$ then, the corresponding system of equations is

$$
{\begin{aligned}0x-8y+4z=-\frac{7}{4} \\ 0x+5y+\frac{2}{3}z=8 \\ \frac{3}{2}x+\frac{1}{3}y+4z=6.\end{aligned}
$$

By simplifying, we obtain 

$$
{\begin{aligned}-8y+4z=-\frac{7}{4} \\ 5y+\frac{2}{3}z=8 \\ \frac{3}{2}x+\frac{1}{3}y+4z=6.\end{aligned}
$$

b
{x−8y+4z=−74x+5y+23z=832x+13y+4z=6

EXPLANATION

The augmented matrix consists of two parts: the coefficient matrix and the column of constants.

The coefficient matrix represents the coefficients in the linear system, while the column of constants represents the constants on the right-hand sides of the equations.

Using the variables x, y, and z, then, the corresponding system of equations is

{0x−8y+4z=−740x+5y+23z=832x+13y+4z=6.

By simplifying, we obtain

{−8y+4z=−745y+23z=832x+13y+4z=6.

verification.explanation: The worked solution confirms option c. The columns represent x, y, z, and the constant; the zero x coefficients remove x from the first two equations.

content.knowledge_point: Finding the System of Equations Associated With an Augmented Matrix
content.problem:
What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

$$
[\begin{aligned}0 & -8 & 4 & -\frac{7}{4} \\ 0 & 5 & \frac{2}{3} & 8 \\ \frac{3}{2} & \frac{1}{3} & 4 & 6\end{aligned}]
$$
content.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix consists of two parts: the coefficient matrix and the column of constants.

The coefficient matrix represents the coefficients in the linear system, while the column of constants represents the constants on the right-hand sides of the equations.

Using the variables $x$, $y$, and $z,$ then, the corresponding system of equations is

$$
{\begin{aligned}0x-8y+4z=-\frac{7}{4} \\ 0x+5y+\frac{2}{3}z=8 \\ \frac{3}{2}x+\frac{1}{3}y+4z=6.\end{aligned}
$$

By simplifying, we obtain 

$$
{\begin{aligned}-8y+4z=-\frac{7}{4} \\ 5y+\frac{2}{3}z=8 \\ \frac{3}{2}x+\frac{1}{3}y+4z=6.\end{aligned}
$$

before.html:
Question 12
?

What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

[14−23−11−122211]

a
{x+4y−2z=3−x+y−z=12x+2y+z=2
b
{x+2y−4z=3−x+y−z=22x+2y+z=1
c
{x+4y−2z=3x+y+z=22x+2y+z=1
d
{x+4y−2z=3−x+y−z=22x+2y+z=1
e
{x+4y−2z=3−x+y−z=22x+y+2z=1
Submit

decision.explanation: Each row gives the x, y, z coefficients followed by the constant: x+4y-2z=3, -x+y-z=2, and 2x+2y+z=1. This matches option d.

after.name: Question 12
after.problem:
What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 4 & -2 & 3 \\ -1 & 1 & -1 & 2 \\ 2 & 2 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$
after.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix consists of two parts: the coefficient matrix and the column of constants.

The coefficient matrix represents the coefficients in the linear system, while the column of constants represents the constants on the right-hand sides of the equations.

Using the variables $x$, $y$, and $z,$ then, the corresponding system of equations is

$$
{\begin{aligned}x+4y-2z=3 \\ -x+y-z=2 \\ 2x+2y+z=1.\end{aligned}
$$

Question 12
?

What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

[14−23−11−122211]

a
{x+4y−2z=3−x+y−z=12x+2y+z=2
b
{x+2y−4z=3−x+y−z=22x+2y+z=1
c
{x+4y−2z=3x+y+z=22x+2y+z=1
d
{x+4y−2z=3−x+y−z=22x+2y+z=1
e
{x+4y−2z=3−x+y−z=22x+y+2z=1
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

The augmented matrix consists of two parts: the coefficient matrix and the column of constants.

The coefficient matrix represents the coefficients in the linear system, while the column of constants represents the constants on the right-hand sides of the equations.

Using the variables x, y, and z, then, the corresponding system of equations is

{x+4y−2z=3−x+y−z=22x+2y+z=1.

content.knowledge_point: Finding the System of Equations Associated With an Augmented Matrix
content.problem:
What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 4 & -2 & 3 \\ -1 & 1 & -1 & 2 \\ 2 & 2 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$
content.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix consists of two parts: the coefficient matrix and the column of constants.

The coefficient matrix represents the coefficients in the linear system, while the column of constants represents the constants on the right-hand sides of the equations.

Using the variables $x$, $y$, and $z,$ then, the corresponding system of equations is

$$
{\begin{aligned}x+4y-2z=3 \\ -x+y-z=2 \\ 2x+2y+z=1.\end{aligned}
$$

Question 13
?

What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

[08641−9]

a
{8y=64x+y=−9
b
{8y=6x+4y=9
c
{x+8y=64x+y=9
d
{8x+y=64x+y=−9
e
{8y=6x+4y=−9
Submit

decision.explanation: The columns give the x coefficient, y coefficient, and constant. The rows therefore represent 0x+8y=6 and 4x+y=-9, matching option a.

after.name: Question 13
after.problem:
What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

$$
[\begin{aligned}0 & 8 & 6 \\ 4 & 1 & -9\end{aligned}]
$$
after.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix consists of two parts: the coefficient matrix and the column of constants.

The coefficient matrix represents the coefficients in the linear system, while the column of constants represents the constants on the right-hand sides of the equations.

Using the variables $x$ and  $y$,  the corresponding system of equations is

$$
{\begin{aligned}0x+8y=6 \\ 4x+y=-9.\end{aligned}
$$

By simplifying, we obtain

$$
{\begin{aligned}8y=6 \\ 4x+y=-9.\end{aligned}
$$

after.html:
Question 13
?

What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

[08641−9]

a
{8y=64x+y=−9
b
{8y=6x+4y=9
c
{x+8y=64x+y=9
d
{8x+y=64x+y=−9
e
{8y=6x+4y=−9
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

The augmented matrix consists of two parts: the coefficient matrix and the column of constants.

The coefficient matrix represents the coefficients in the linear system, while the column of constants represents the constants on the right-hand sides of the equations.

Using the variables x and y, the corresponding system of equations is

{0x+8y=64x+y=−9.

By simplifying, we obtain

{8y=64x+y=−9.

verification.explanation: The worked solution confirms option a: the rows represent 0x+8y=6 and 4x+y=-9. Removing the zero term gives 8y=6 and 4x+y=-9.

content.knowledge_point: Finding the System of Equations Associated With an Augmented Matrix
content.problem:
What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

$$
[\begin{aligned}0 & 8 & 6 \\ 4 & 1 & -9\end{aligned}]
$$
content.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix consists of two parts: the coefficient matrix and the column of constants.

The coefficient matrix represents the coefficients in the linear system, while the column of constants represents the constants on the right-hand sides of the equations.

Using the variables $x$ and  $y$,  the corresponding system of equations is

$$
{\begin{aligned}0x+8y=6 \\ 4x+y=-9.\end{aligned}
$$

By simplifying, we obtain

$$
{\begin{aligned}8y=6 \\ 4x+y=-9.\end{aligned}
$$

$$

decision.explanation: Read each row as x, y, z coefficients followed by the constant. This gives 4x+y+z=1/2, (1/4)x+2z=6, and 3x+(1/2)y+6z=1/3, matching option d.

after.name: Question 14
after.problem:
What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

$$
[\begin{aligned}4 & 1 & 1 & \frac{1}{2} \\ \frac{1}{4} & 0 & 2 & 6 \\ 3 & \frac{1}{2} & 6 & \frac{1}{3}\end{aligned}]
$$
after.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix consists of two parts: the coefficient matrix and the column of constants.

The coefficient matrix represents the coefficients in the linear system, while the column of constants represents the constants on the right-hand sides of the equations.

Using the variables $x$, $y$, and $z,$ then, the corresponding system of equations is

$$
{\begin{aligned}4x+y+z=\frac{1}{2} \\ \frac{1}{4}x-0y+2z=6 \\ 3x+\frac{1}{2}y+6z=\frac{1}{3}.\end{aligned}
$$

By simplifying, we obtain 

$$
{\begin{aligned}4x+y+z=\frac{1}{2} \\ \frac{1}{4}x+2z=6 \\ 3x+\frac{1}{2}y+6z=\frac{1}{3}.\end{aligned}
$$

What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

a
{4x+y+z=1214x+z=−63x+12y+6z=13
b
{4x+y+z=1214x+2z=63x−12y+6z=13
c
{4x+y+z=1214x−2z=63x+12y+6z=13
d
{4x+y+z=1214x+2z=63x+12y+6z=13
e
{4x−y+z=1214x+2z=63x+12y+6z=13
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

The augmented matrix consists of two parts: the coefficient matrix and the column of constants.

The coefficient matrix represents the coefficients in the linear system, while the column of constants represents the constants on the right-hand sides of the equations.

Using the variables x, y, and z, then, the corresponding system of equations is

{4x+y+z=1214x−0y+2z=63x+12y+6z=13.

By simplifying, we obtain

{4x+y+z=1214x+2z=63x+12y+6z=13.

content.knowledge_point: Finding the System of Equations Associated With an Augmented Matrix
content.problem:
What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

$$
[\begin{aligned}4 & 1 & 1 & \frac{1}{2} \\ \frac{1}{4} & 0 & 2 & 6 \\ 3 & \frac{1}{2} & 6 & \frac{1}{3}\end{aligned}]
$$
content.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix consists of two parts: the coefficient matrix and the column of constants.

The coefficient matrix represents the coefficients in the linear system, while the column of constants represents the constants on the right-hand sides of the equations.

Using the variables $x$, $y$, and $z,$ then, the corresponding system of equations is

$$
{\begin{aligned}4x+y+z=\frac{1}{2} \\ \frac{1}{4}x-0y+2z=6 \\ 3x+\frac{1}{2}y+6z=\frac{1}{3}.\end{aligned}
$$

By simplifying, we obtain 

$$
{\begin{aligned}4x+y+z=\frac{1}{2} \\ \frac{1}{4}x+2z=6 \\ 3x+\frac{1}{2}y+6z=\frac{1}{3}.\end{aligned}
$$

before.html:
Question 15
?

What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

[1−510−2−3−15]

a
{x−5y=1−2x−3y=−5
b
{x−5y=102x−3y=−16
c
{x−5y=102x−3y=−18
d
{−5x−y=10−3x−2y=−5
e
{x−5y=10−2x−3y=−15
Submit

decision.explanation: Reading each row as the x coefficient, y coefficient, and constant gives x-5y=10 and -2x-3y=-15, matching option e.

after.name: Question 15
after.problem:
What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & -5 & 10 \\ -2 & -3 & -15\end{aligned}]
$$
after.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix consists of two parts: the coefficient matrix and the column of constants.

The coefficient matrix represents the coefficients in the linear system, while the column of constants represents the constants on the right-hand sides of the equations.

Using the variables $x$ and  $y$,  the corresponding system of equations is

$$
{\begin{aligned}x-5y=10 \\ -2x-3y=-15\end{aligned}
$$

EXPLANATION

The augmented matrix consists of two parts: the coefficient matrix and the column of constants.

content.knowledge_point: Finding the System of Equations Associated With an Augmented Matrix
content.problem:
What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & -5 & 10 \\ -2 & -3 & -15\end{aligned}]
$$
content.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix consists of two parts: the coefficient matrix and the column of constants.

The coefficient matrix represents the coefficients in the linear system, while the column of constants represents the constants on the right-hand sides of the equations.

Using the variables $x$ and  $y$,  the corresponding system of equations is

$$
{\begin{aligned}x-5y=10 \\ -2x-3y=-15\end{aligned}
$$

decision.explanation: Using columns for p, q, and the constant gives rows (1, 3, 2) and (9, -4, 1), matching option a.

after.name: Question 16
after.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}p+3q=2 \\ 9p-4q=1\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
after.worked_solution:
Notice that the system is already organized so that the variables are in the order $p,q$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient.   

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables: 

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 \\ 9 & -4\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & 2 \\ 9 & -4 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

content.knowledge_point: Finding the Augmented Matrix of a Linear System With Variables Other Than x, y, z
content.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}p+3q=2 \\ 9p-4q=1\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
content.worked_solution:
Notice that the system is already organized so that the variables are in the order $p,q$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient.   

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables: 

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 \\ 9 & -4\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & 2 \\ 9 & -4 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

Question 17

What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

{x1−x2=−1x1+x2=−1

a
[−11−11−1−1]
b
[−11−1−111]
c
[1−10110]
d
[1−1−111−1]
e
[1−111−1−1]
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

Notice that the system is already organized so that the variables are in the order x1,x2 on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient.

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

[1−111]

The augmented matrix is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

[1−1−111−1]

content.knowledge_point: Finding the Augmented Matrix of a Linear System With Variables Other Than x, y, z
content.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-{x}_{2}=-1 \\ {x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=-1\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
content.worked_solution:
Notice that the system is already organized so that the variables are in the order ${x}_{1},{x}_{2}$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient.   

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables: 

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 \\ 1 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & -1 \\ 1 & 1 & -1\end{aligned}]
$$

Question 18
?

What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

{u−v=−1−u−v=1

a
[1−1−1−1−11]
b
[−111−1−1−1]
c
[−11−1111]
d
[−11−1−1−11]
e
[−11−1−1−11]
Submit

decision.explanation: Using columns for u, v, and the constant gives rows (1, -1, -1) and (-1, -1, 1), matching option a.

after.name: Question 18
after.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}u-v=-1 \\ -u-v=1\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
after.worked_solution:
Notice that the system is already organized so that the variables are in the order $u,v$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient.   

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables: 

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 \\ -1 & -1\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & -1 \\ -1 & -1 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

after.html:
Question 18
?

What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

{u−v=−1−u−v=1

a
[1−1−1−1−11]
b
[−111−1−1−1]
c
[−11−1111]
d
[−11−1−1−11]
e
[−11−1−1−11]
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

Notice that the system is already organized so that the variables are in the order u,v on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient.

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

[1−1−1−1]

The augmented matrix is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

[1−1−1−1−11]

verification.explanation: The worked solution confirms option a: the u and v coefficients followed by the constants give rows (1, -1, -1) and (-1, -1, 1).

content.knowledge_point: Finding the Augmented Matrix of a Linear System With Variables Other Than x, y, z
content.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}u-v=-1 \\ -u-v=1\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
content.worked_solution:
Notice that the system is already organized so that the variables are in the order $u,v$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient.   

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables: 

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 \\ -1 & -1\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & -1 \\ -1 & -1 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

decision.explanation: Order the variables as x₁, x₂, x₃ and rewrite the first equation as 4x₁+2x₂-3x₃=0. The coefficient rows are (4, 2, -3) and (0, 0, -11), excluding constants, so option b is correct.

after.name: Question 19
after.problem:
What is the coefficient matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}2{x}_{2}+4{x}_{1}=3{x}_{3} \\ -11{x}_{3}=12\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
after.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered ${x}_{1},{x}_{2},{x}_{3}$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}4{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2}-3{x}_{3}=0 \\ 0{x}_{1}+0{x}_{2}-11{x}_{3}=12\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}4 & 2 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & -11\end{aligned}]
$$

decision.explanation: Using columns for x₁, x₂, and the constant gives rows (3, 5, -5) and (5, 3, -3), matching option c.

after.name: Question 20
after.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}3{x}_{1}+5{x}_{2}=-5 \\ 5{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2}=-3\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
after.worked_solution:
Notice that the system is already organized so that the variables are in the order ${x}_{1},{x}_{2}$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient.   

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables: 

$$
[\begin{aligned}3 & 5 \\ 5 & 3\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
[\begin{aligned}3 & 5 & -5 \\ 5 & 3 & -3\end{aligned}]
$$

content.knowledge_point: Finding the Augmented Matrix of a Linear System With Variables Other Than x, y, z
content.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}3{x}_{1}+5{x}_{2}=-5 \\ 5{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2}=-3\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
content.worked_solution:
Notice that the system is already organized so that the variables are in the order ${x}_{1},{x}_{2}$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient.   

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables: 

$$
[\begin{aligned}3 & 5 \\ 5 & 3\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
[\begin{aligned}3 & 5 & -5 \\ 5 & 3 & -3\end{aligned}]
$$
